Commentary.Commentary: Looking ahead, the pitch is doing all sorts of things if you bowl in the right areas. It is not easy for batting but at the same time, not impossible to bat too. The onus will be on the Indian openers, who will have to deal with the new ball. The hosts' new ball bowlers will look to pick up early wickets, knowing especially how jittery the visitors' middle order is. Let us see what happens. The Indian reply begins in just a bit.

India will be relieved. They have finally managed to pick the remaining wickets. But it wasn't easy this morning in spite of helpful conditions. 49 precious runs added by the home team's lower order. A bit of an abrupt end as at one time it was looking like 350 was a sure thing. The Aussies will be happy with the scorecard seeing 326 on the board but there will also be a slight worry that none of their batsmen went on to make a big score despite 3 of them reaching 50 and Marsh getting to 45. The highest scorer was Marcus Harris with 70. The important point though was that the tail did wag again and helped them go past 300. What remains to be seen is whether this total is enough as India are yet to bat. On the bowling front, Ishant was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up 4 wickets. Bumrah, Yadav and Vihari picked up two apiece as Shami went wicketless. All in all, the feeling is that it is a par score, maybe Australia slightly ahead.

OUT! Ishant gets four and AUSTRALIA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 326. Excellent delivery again, it's angled in from 'round the wicket in the direction of the stumps. Hazlewood has to play at it but to his misfortune, it's an outswinger which kisses the outside edge of his blade. Pant dives across to his left to take a fine catch. Second golden duck for Hazlewood, both have come against India in back-to-back Tests. Sharma will be on a hat-trick next time.
Josh Hazlewood is the last batsman in.

OUT! The ninth one departs and Ishant has his third of the innings. A good quick 16-run stand comes to an end. This seems to be the ploy to get Starc out. An action replay of his dismissal at Adelaide. Wide outside off and moves away slightly after landing, Starc goes for a wild drive and gets the outside edge. Pant takes a good catch diving to his left. India doing well here after the Drinks break.
Starts off with one going down leg, Lyon tries to flick and misses. Gets hit on the pad and ball runs down to fine leg for a leg bye.
Ishant replaces Umesh Yadav.
The ball is wide outside off again, and the leftie batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Beaten! This one is well outside off again but Starc is drawn into the shot. He misses the ball as it skims past the outside edge.
Well outside off and left alone by the batsman.
Fuller and on middle, Lyon flicks it away towards mid-wicket and gets to the non-striker's end.
Fuller and angling in on off stump, Mitchell slogs it over mid-wicket. The ball doesn't have enough on it to reach the fence but the batsmen come back for three. That's good running.
Outside off and on a good length from around the wicket, Starc lets it go through.
Shami is back on for another spell.
On a good length but drifting slightly towards leg stump, Starc jams it toward mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.
Short ball and Nathan pulls this away but doesn't time it that well. A single down to deep square leg though.
Well outside off, left alone by the batsman.
Another fuller length ball, Lyon pushes it to the right of mid off and the batsmen are able to come back for the second easily.
Fuller in length and jags in after landing, Lyon jams it towards mid-wicket and comes back for two.

What a ball! Good bowling from Umesh here. This one is again on off and the ball straightens after landing. Lyon goes for the push with a straight bat but misses the ball and it goes just above the off stump. The Indians appeal for a caught behind. There was a noise but it seems to have come from the ball clipping his clothing on the way through.
Angles down at the pads, Starc finds the gap to the left of mid on and gets off the mark. The batsmen come back for a couple.
Quick delivery on top of off stump, 142.3 kmph to be precise. Starc deals with it as he pushes it to mid on.
Around the wicket to the left-hander, outside off and on a good length. Starc pushes it back to Bumrah on one bounce.
Fuller again but Lyon gets his bat down in time as he flicks this away square on the leg side. Picks up three off the first ball he faces.
Nathan Lyon is the new batsman.

OUT! Paine is on his bike! Two quick wickets for India and their fans in the stands are delighted. Bumrah delivers it from wide of the crease and angles in a length ball on middle. Paine is caught deep inside the crease as he attempts to work it on the leg side. But probably he got beaten for pace as he misses the ball to get rapped on the pads. They appeal and the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. Paine takes the review but to no avail. Three reds. He has to go but not before playing a very vital knock for his team. So, Australia now have two new batsmen in the middle who are yet to face a ball. Can India finish things quickly now?
Tim Paine has been adjudged lbw! Looks dead in front. But he has taken a review.
Angles in a length delivery around off, Paine covers the line by staying inside the crease and defends it out to the off side.
Mitchell Starc is the next batsman in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! The seventh wicket is gone after a 59-run stand and India will be relieved. Umesh has been really good this over and Pat was in two minds because of the length that the bowler has been hitting. This one is just a little fuller and lands on off. The ball seems to be coming in with the angle but straightens in the end and beats the outside edge of Cummins' bat as he looks to defend. It goes on to hit the top of the off pole. Dream delivery for any seamer! This is what was required since the beginning for the visitors.
Fuller outside off, Cummins pushes it to point coming half-ahead.
Bouncer on middle and Cummins ducks under this one at the last moment.
Cummins is ahead to this one and defends it watchfully back to the bowler.

What a jaffa! It is too good for Pat. Starts off just outside off, seems to be coming in and straightens a bit in the end to beat the outside edge of the batsman who looked to defend it off the back foot. Unfortunately for India, close to the edge is not enough.
Outside off but it's too wide to make the batsman play.

FOUR! Yorker gone wrong. Jasprit goes for the surprise yorker but it is a full toss on off stump that is gleefully accepted and put away by the skipper down the ground for a boundary. Good way to end the over for the hosts.
OUCH! This one is quick and seems to have got Tim on the hip. Short and jagging in after landing, Paine misses his flick. Winces in pain for a moment but seems okay to continue.
A good bouncer outside off stump, Paine decides against pulling it.
Well left outside the off stump by the Australian captain.
Outside off and short of a length, Paine plays it towards a deepish point. No run taken.
Short leg in place. Good length ball landing on off and coming in slightly, Paine defends it well and into the ground on the leg side.

Drinks break in the morning session on Day 2. A seamless hour for the hosts, have added 29 runs and lost no wickets. The visitors haven't been consistent and trying too many different things while bowling. They need to do something soon, else the game could be going away from them very quickly.
Fuller length ball on middle, Pat pushes this on the front foot back to the bowler.
Tim adjusts well to this one coming back in after landing outside off. He guides it in the gap to the left of point for a single.
Short of length and on off stump. Paine defends it off his back foot.
Another quick one on middle and leg, Paine gets a thick outside edge as he tries to defend this on his toes. The ball rolls towards point.
Shorter ball that seems to have hurried on to the batsman at his hips. Paine adjusts well in the end and fends it towards square leg.
Fuller and swinging away outside off, Paine looks to go for the expansive drive but misses the ball completely.
Good length outside off, Cummins plays a solid shot towards cover-point for no run.

Paine looks to play the pull shot to this shorter one outside off but the ball has hurried onto him. The ball pops up on the leg side but luckily for him, it lands in no-man's land. The batsmen pick up a single.
Another ball on top of off stump, Paine is back in his crease as fends this one off towards cover.
Watchfully played to point with soft hands by the skipper on this occasion.
Good ball from Bumrah, consistently bowling outside off. Paine looks to play at this one but is beaten comprehensively.
Guided down to third man comfortably and Pat gives his skipper the strike.
Fuller length ball outside off, Tim is half-ahead in defense.
Oooh! Paine is late while trying to let that one go, gets the outside edge but luckily for him the ball doesn't carry to Kohli at second slip.
Fuller outside off, defended off the front foot by the Aussie skipper.

Again landing on middle and leg, Cummins misses his flick to get hit above the knee roll. The batsmen scamper through for a quick leg bye. Indians appeal but the ball seems to be going down leg and a tad too high.

Handy partnership, this! Good length ball, drifting down at the pads, Cummins finds the gap this time through mid-wicket and the batsmen come back for the second. 50-run stand comes up between these two, the third 50-plus run stand of this innings.
Slightly short of a length and Cummins pushes it to the square leg fielder.
Play and a miss! The ball is fuller and outside off, Paine looks to feel the ball as it straightens and beats the outside edge at the last moment. Good start from Bumrah.
Short and aimed above the off stump, Tim is uncomfortable in defense but does well to not let the ball fly off the edge.

Short ball at the stumps again, Pat defends it with soft hands and picks up a quick single. That single also brings up the 300 for the hosts. Interesting - The last time Australia lost a Test after scoring 300-plus in the first innings was the Boxing Day Test against South Africa at the MCG in 2008.
What carry here! This is on a good length and rises as it goes past the stumps. Paine was looking to place it on the off side but misses. Pant collects it at head height.
Good ball outside off on a length, just straightens a bit after landing. Tim is beaten on the outside edge as he tries to defend from within the crease.
Short and well outside off, Cummins lets it go.
Jasprit Bumrah comes into the attack now.
Outside off and left alone by the skipper.

Short ball outside off, Cummins looks to half-cut, half-drive it off the back foot towards covers. Gets the inside half of the bat as the ball runs to the right of Rahul at short cover. The batsmen pick up a single as the fielder trips while fielding the ball.
Closer to off stump, Pat has to play at this one as he defends it towards mid off.
Another ball outside off, a good start this by Umesh. The batsman shoulders arms to it once more.
Slightly shorter this time outside off, Pat watches it go through.
Outside off on a length to start off with, left alone by Cummins.
Umesh Yadav is the first bowling change of the morning.
Another ball that is going a little down leg, Paine misses his flick and gets hit on the thigh pad. No run here though.
Overpitched on middle and leg, Cummins gets a single towards mid-wicket. Easy runs these for the Aussies.
Short and going down leg, left alone by Pat.

Fuller on this occasion, the inswing beats Cummins and gets him on his knee roll. The Indians appeal but the umpire is unmoved. The ball seemed to be a little too high and even Virat gestures the same to the bowler. Good decision not to review as Hawk-Eye shows that the ball was going above the stumps.

Slightly short of a good length and jags back in after landing, Paine gets an inside edge onto his pad and the ball rolls onto the leg side. The batsmen pick up yet another quick single here. Given as a leg bye, so maybe there wasn't any wood.
Very full and on middle, Paine keeps it out towards mid-wicket.
Back to the good line and length outside off, Cummins leaves it alone. Needs to bowl this line more consistently.
Another short one aimed at the head, Paine pulls it fine but the connection is not so good. Just a single down to fine leg.
Shorter and outside off, Shami seems to be trying too hard. Paine pulls this away in front of square leg and comes back for two.

Shorter ball and aimed at the batsman's hips. Cummins misses the flick and gets hit on the hip. The ball rolls down on the leg side and the batsmen spot a quick leg bye available. They make it easily in the end.
Another one outside off and left alone again by the batsman.
Fuller length ball outside off, Pat shoulders his arms to it.
Outside off and just ahead of a good length, Paine is well forward as he defends this.
Good length delivery again on middle, Paine pushes it to mid-wicket. Wants the single but is sent back by Cummins.
Good ball that from Sharma, just on the probing line and length on off, Paine is solid in defense though.
A bumper on off and middle, Paine ducks under it and lets it go.
Fuller delivery now, on the off stump line. Paine plays it watchfully straight back down the ground.
Shorter ball going down leg, Cummins jumps a bit and keeps it down as he plays it to fine leg. Picks up a single.
FOUR! That should give him confidence after that blow. Outside off and short, Tim just has to place it in the gap to the left of point and the ball runs away to the fence.
Oops what happened there? A short ball, and some variable bounce here. Paine goes for the pull but the ball does not bounce as much as he expects. He misses the ball and gets hit on the thigh.
Another effort ball from Shami, well outside off on this occasion. Paine was lining up for the pull but then decides against it seeing the line of the ball.
Short of a length and outside off, Paine stands tall and defends it to cover.
On the channel outside off again, left to go through to Pant.
Good bouncer! Short and aimed at the head, Paine does equally well to duck under it, keeping his eyes on the ball all the while.
The last ball is well left outside the off stump by Pat.

Full and outside off, Paine plays it with soft hands and sets through for a quick single but it was straight at cover. Rahul, though cannot pick up the ball. If he had collected it cleanly and hit the stumps, Cummins would have been a goner.
Outside off, Paine defends it on his toes towards cover.
Yet another ball that is angling down at the pads, Cummins turns it away to fine leg and gets to the other end.

Ishant hasn't got his line quite right yet here, he is sliding down the leg side. This one is short and going down leg. Cummins fails to get bat as he tries to glide it fine for four. Pant collects it at chest height.
Fuller ball on the pads, Paine works it away in front of square on the leg side for a single.

Oooh! Just outside off, the batsman wanted to leave it but was a little late in shouldering his arms there. The ball hits the inside edge but luckily for him, it goes on to his pads. Could have gone on to the stumps as well. Seems like he was caught in two minds there.
Well outside off and safely seen through to the keeper.
Short ball that jags in a bit after landing on off. Cummins does well to adjust and plays it safely to the mid-wicket fielder.
Shorter in length outside off, guided down to third man all along the ground. Paine gets to the other end.
Outside off and left alone this time by Tim.

FOUR! First boundary of the morning as Shami attempts the shorter ball. It is outside off and allows Paine to free his arms and pull it away behind square. It was in the air but no fielder there and the ball strolls over the fence for four runs.
Well left this time, as the ball comes in slightly after landing but in the end, is well away from the off pole.
Good ball first up to Pat, outside off and moving away after landing. The batsman feels for the ball tentatively and ends up getting beaten.
Shorter and well outside off on this occasion, Tim guides it down towards third man and gets a single to give Cummins the strike for the first time today.

Oh, what happened here? Starts on middle and leg and angles down the leg side. Paine was looking to flick it away but misses. The ball hits his pad and goes through to Pant. No appeal as the ball was going down leg.
Another one a little more outside off, Tim shoulders his arms once more.
Good length and just outside off, it is left alone well by the skipper.
Ishant Sharma to bowl from the other end.
Short of a length and at the hips, the first run of the day as Tim just drops it on the leg side and gets to the other end. Also, keeps strike for the next over.
Overpitched on this occasion on the off stump line, Paine gets his bat to this one as he pushes it to cover.
Back to outside off and just short of a length, left alone again.
This one is sliding down the leg side and the skipper wants nothing to do with it as he lets it go.
Similar length but the ball comes in after landing. Paine gauges the movement and then lets it go.
Good start first up, on a good length outside off and flies through to Rishabh Pant as Tim shoulders his arms to it.
The players and the umpires are walking out on to the field of play. Tim Paine to face the first ball of Day 2 which will be bowled by Mohammed Shami.

Pitch Report - Michael Vaughan with the pitch report. Starting with the overhead conditions, he says that there is a little bit of cloud cover which will make it cooler. Adds that there is plenty of grass cover and it made it uneven and difficult for the batsmen, should continue to be the same. With already 277 on the board, he feels that the Aussies are on top as it won't become any easier for batting.

The Aussie fast bowlers will be licking their lips on the prospect of bowling on this quick pitch, also with the weather conditions turning this way that should aid them. They won't tire as much as they would have, bowling under the sun. The spinner, Nathan Lyon should also be excited seeing the amount of bounce Hanuma Vihari extracted yesterday. Should be an exhilarating day's play. Stay tuned with us for action which begins in some time!

Hello and welcome to Day 2 of the second Test of the Border-Gavaskar trophy. After a brilliant day of Test cricket on the first day at this state-of-the-art stadium, we have had a really heavy gale accompanied with slight showers last night. Yesterday was a hot day, and the gale has just changed the whole complexion, it is cool and cloudy and expected to remain the same throughout the day. Coming to the cricket, Australia are 277-6 and India will be looking to wipe off the tail as soon as possible and restrict the runs. As for the hosts, they will look to reach 350-400 minimum and if they are successful, that'll put a lot of pressure on the visitors.
... Day 2, Session 1 ...

Right then! Do Australia have enough? if you believe Twitterati, they do. If you look logically, they do. But the same feeling came when India made a 'meager' 250 in Adelaide. So as Michael Clarke always says - 'Never judge a pitch till both sides have batted on it.' So wait for the second innings to unfold and then make a judgement. But for that, you need to follow the game, don't you? Join us back at 10.20 am local (0220 GMT) for all the action on Day 2. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Did India miss a spinner? Were their pacers tired? Looking at the cracks opening up, surely Ashwin, Jadeja or Kuldeep would have been handy. Yes, Ashwin is injured but the other two would have been mighty effective, especially in the second innings. Very unlikely from this fitness-freaking Indian side but only Bumrah looked the fittest and fastest. Ishant picked up 2 wickets but he struggled for a major part of the day. Umesh Yadav was expensive and inaccurate while Shami was unlucky not to pick up a wicket. Talk about luck, what about Hanuma Vihari? First, he got rid of the set Harris, then broke the dangerous 84-run stand between Marsh and Head.

If anything, what will disappoint the Kangaroos is the way both Marsh and Head threw it away. The 84-run stand was causing frustration for the Indians but getting both of them in the span of 32 balls would have boosted the visitors' hopes. The Aussies could have easily been 4 or 5 down, but now, they have allowed the Indians to keep them pinned down under 300.

Runs on the board are always important and the hosts have them. They stuck to the age-old technique of see ball, watch ball and the openers benefitted. There was a bit of a stutter in the middle, as Australia lost 4/36 in the span of 114 balls but after that, Marsh and Head ensured that India spent more time in the field searching for wickets.

Exciting day of cricket. Both teams would take this. India will love because Australia were 112/0 at one stage and cruising, as if they had suddenly been reminded that the Hayden-Langer era had re-begun. The hosts would be happy too, as divots have already started to appear and the pitch is starting to be up and down on Day 1 already. So this looks like a good score.

HUGE, HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW! Not out says the umpire! Inside edge, indicates Bumrah to his skipper. Boy, that looked close. Full and around off, coming back in sharply, Cummins looked to defend but got squared up. He is hit on the pads and India appeal but wood saves Patrick. STUMPS ON DAY 1, AUSTRALIA END ON 277/6!
A bouncer around middle, watchfully ducked under.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Around off, defended from the crease to the off side.
Outside off, Pat feels for it but misses.
Around off, solidly defended.
Full and around middle, Cummins looks to defend but gets an inside edge to the leg side. A quick run taken.

WIDE. Excellent take from Pant. A wild bouncer, down leg, PC ducks while Rishabh rises. Flies like an eagle and pouches his prey with one glove. Save aside that drop of Marsh, he has been excellent today.
Full and outside off, Pat punches this through the covers for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Uppish, but safe. Outside off, Cummins plays away from his body and gets an outside edge, which does not carry to point.
Outside off, punched wide of cover for a single.
Outside off, left alone.
Mohammed Shami returns. 18-3-58-0 so far.

TOP EDGE, SAFE! Hmmm... may not be the wisest of shots at this stage. A short ball, around off, Paine swivels to pull but does not quite middle it. The ball flies off the top edge but does not carry to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point.

A bit on the fuller side, around middle, worked wide of Ishant Sharma at mid on. He does get to it before the ball meets the ropes but the batsmen take three by that time. The stand now moves to 20 from 33 balls.
A good bouncer but way too short, outside off, easy duck for Cummins.
Around off, pushed towards point.
On a length outside off, solidly defended.
Length delivery on off, Paine defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Back of a length outside off, the captain shoulders arms to it.
Fuller delivery on off, the captain drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Length delivery on middle, Paine defends it with a straight bat.
Length delivery on middle, Cummins taps it towards gully for a run.
Fuller delivery around off, Pat lets it go.

The yorker to follow the bouncer. Too quick for Cummins as the ball raps him on his toes before he brings his bat down. Bumrah goes up in appeal but the ball seems to be going down leg to the naked eye. The batsmen run through for a leg bye. Virat asks Pant and then decides not to review.
A bouncer and outside off, Cummins ducks under it and lets it go.
Another ball that is short of a length, Paine has enough time on it to push it in the gap towards mid-wicket and get to the other end.
Short of a length and outside off, Paine stands inside his crease and defends it back to the bowler.
Overpitched on this occasion, Cummins flicks it away to fine leg for a single.
Another incredible delivery! The ball lands on off and straightens so much that it beats the outside edge of Pat who was looking to defend on the front foot. Misses the off stump by a whisker again.
FOUR! Short from Umesh and Tim Paine gets into the position early and pulls it towards mid-wicket region for a boundary. The captain needs to hang in there for a longer period of time.
Fuller length from Umesh on off, TP drives it straight to the point fielder.
Short and wide outside off, Pat cuts it towards point for a run.
Length delivery on off, PC opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a couple of runs. He is off the mark with that shot.
Good delivery that from Umesh. A touch fuller around off, Cummins going for a expansive drive but misses it completely.
Length delivery around off, Pat lets it go.
Umesh Yadav comes back into the attack.
Short and at the pads, flicked away to deep backward square leg. The batsmen come back for two, that's good running between the wickets.
Finally a sense of calm as the ball is finally on the bat of Paine. He defends with soft hands to gully.

FOUR Byes! Unbelieveable! What a ball once again from Jasprit! How it has missed the off stump no one knows. The ball beats everything, including a lunging Pant who cannot reach the ball and it goes for four byes. Paine cannot believe what just happened there. The ball lands on off and moves away after landing. Completely beats Paine as he tries to play at it but cannot get bat on ball. Misses the edge, off stump and the keeper's gloves.

What a jaffa! The ball landed on a length outside off and straightens after landing. Paine who was looking to defend gets completely squared up and the ball goes to Pant at above chest height. There is an amazed look on the face of the batsman.
Wayward and too full. Tim takes it on the full but can only get it as far as point.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, the ball comes in a long way but Paine judges the swing and leaves it alone.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack.
Well outside off, Cummins decides to trust the bounce of the wicket and let it go even as the ball came in a long way. Good leave in the end, it must be said.
Another length delivery just outside off, and well defended by the right-hander once again.
Cummins gets this defense on the middle of the bat after covering the swing. Should make him feel confident.
Well outside off and Pat chooses to leave this one.
Outside off and coming in after landing, Cummins is ahead and defends confidently.
Pat Cummins walks in at no. 8.

OUT! What a waste of a wicket! Head has literally thrown his wicket away. Loose and should be very disappointed. Australia lose their sixth. Ishant has got a wicket off his first ball with the second cherry. A loosener from Sharma to start off with. Well outside off and fuller in length. Head loses his composure as he goes chasing after this wide one and goes for an expansive drive. The ball takes the thick outside edge and carries to Shami who is at third man. Head thumps his pad with his bat as soon as the catch is completed to show his displeasure. And why not. India slowly clawing their way back, will look to finish the day strong.
Ishant Sharma to bowl with the new ball from the other end.
Full length delivery angling across, Paine goes for the drive but misses it completely. Good end to the end from Shami.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery on off, Head opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a run.
A touch fuller on off, Head leans forward and tries to drive it but gets the inner of the bat and the ball goes towards mid off.
Good delivery that. Full length around off, Head stands firm on the crease and lets it go to the keeper.
Short of a length delivery around off, Head tries to cut it but misses it completely.
The new ball has been taken. Shami to bowl with it.
250 comes up for the hosts! Vihari bowls this one at the pads and Travis flicks it away to deep backward square leg for a single.

Shorter delivery again and Paine wants to pull this one. He is late on the shot and the ball goes down the wicket to long on instead of mid-wicket. It is slightly in the air but no fielder present so it's safe. The batsmen exchange strike.
Flatter and quicker delivery outside off. Paine lets it go. This one bounces a lot more.
FOUR! Full toss outside off and demanding punishment. Paine gives it just that as he drives it beautifully through the covers for four.
Another similar delivery, Paine pushes it towards mid-wicket.
They haven't taken it just yet. Hanuma continues and bowls the first one a length and just outside off. Tim defends it watchfully off his back foot.
The new ball is available now!
FOUR! Cuts and cuts hard. Length delivery on off, Head slashes it hard towards the backward point region and the ball races away to the fence.
Fuller length on off, Head defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and wide outside off, Paine taps it towards covers for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Tim works it to the leg side.
In the channel outside off, TP lets it go.
Bowls it short on off, Head pulls it towards mid on and the batsmen manage to take a single in the process.
Third time that Paine has played the square cut this over and third time he has found this fielder. This time he tried to find the gap to the left but it was too close to Shami again.
Outside off and Paine cuts it hard again but straight to Shami at point.
Fuller this time, the batsman comes ahead and defends it with a straight bat.
Very short and well wide outside off, Paine stays back and cuts it but straight to backward point.
Arm ball outside off, Tim is half-ahead as he defends it with soft hands.
Short outside off, Head stands tall and cuts it to deep point for a single.

Back of a length on off, Head taps it towards point and the batsman cross ends. Also brings up Head's 3rd fifty. Brilliant innings from the southpaw. He has been probably Australia's best batsman in this tour. Australia would like him to bat for a longer period of time.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Head flicks it towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Short of a length around off, Paine taps it towards point for a run. The captain is off the mark with that.
Back of a length on off, Head guides it towards point for a single.
Play and Miss! Length delivery around off, Head tries to poke at it but luckily for him he did not get the outside edge of the bat. Good delivery from Shami that.
Starts off with a length delivery on middle, Head defends it off the front foot and onto the ground.
Shami is back into the attack.
Tim Paine, the skipper is the next batsman in.

OUT! What a catch by Rahane! He has held on to a really tough one here! Marsh cannot believe his luck. The ball was short outside off and demanded treatmet. Shaun looks to cut hard but only gets an edge that was traveling fast. Rahane at slip stays on his feet and takes the ball with the support of his chest as he somehow holds onto it. He falls backward after taking the catch but ensures the ball is stuck in his hand. India have their fifth against the run of play. Vihari, the 'part-timer' has his second. 232-5 now.
Shorter outside off and the ball is pushed through the covers. Head runs to the other end.
Another single as the ball is driven by Marsh.
Flatter delivery outside off, pushed in the gap towards cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, Travis comes ahead and defends it with a straight bat.
Flighted outside off, Head leans into the drive and gets it to deep cover for a couple.
FOUR! Flighted on middle, Marsh comes down the track and drives it straight past the bowler and through the mid on fielder for a boundary. 10 from the over of Vijay.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Head comes down the track and tries to go over mid on. But he miscues it and the ball falls just short of the mid on fielder. They take a run in the end.
Flatter on middle, Head defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Short outside off, Marsh punches it off the backfoot towards the point region for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings there for Marsh. Drags it short on middle, Marsh flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the boundary.
Starts off with a fuller delivery on middle, Marsh defends it with a straight bat.
Murali Vijay will roll his arm over. India seem to be looking to finish the last few overs before the new ball is available quickly.
Oooh! Short outside off and Travis cannot hold back the cut. Goes for it and misses the ball completely. Lucky not to get an edge there.

FOUR! This is played late, very late by Head. Short and well outside off, Head is deep in his crease and cuts the ball very late to the backward point boundary for four runs. Found the gap beautifully behind backward point this time.
Fuller on this occasio, Travis comes well ahead to defend this back to the bowler.
Flatter delivery outside off, Head defends it off the back foot to point.
Flighted outside off on this occasion, Head comes down the track and defends this to cover.
Short and outside off, cut through to backward point.
Well outside off and very short, Marsh shoulders his arms to it.
Good ball outside off and on a fuller length. Slight movement in the air but Marsh deals well with it and defends it towards cover-point.
Wide outside off and SM lets this one go through to Pant.
Slightly overpitched outside off, Shaun drives it straight to cover.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump again.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and around middle, Marsh looks to defend but the ball scoots in and goes off the inside edge through square leg. A single taken.
A touch short, around off, turned towards short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Oohhh... an LBW appeal, turned down. Full and outside off, Marsh pads it away. That was coming in with the angle but didn't seem like it will hit the stumps.
Tossed up outside off, Head dances down the track and drives it towards long off for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a single.
Landed outside off, left alone.

Flashy drive and escapes again. In the process of scoring runs quickly, Australia are playing too many shots, one feels. Wide outside off, fuller in length, Head leans into the shot, but does not quite move his feet again. The ball flies off the edge, through point but the man is deep. It races towards the fence but substitute Ravindra Jadeja hares after it from sweeper cover, gets to the ball and keeps the batsmen to a couple.

INSIDE EDGE, MISSES THE STUMPS! Loose from Marsh now. Full and outside off, Shaun looks to play a drive through the off side but his feet are glued to the crease. The ball takes the inside but luckily for him, evades the stumps towards fine leg. A single taken.
Outside off, let through again.
Outside off, left alone.
Around off, solidly defended.
Ishant Sharma is back on.

IN THE AIR.... SAFE! FOUR! Heart-in-mouth moment for Head. Full on middle, Travis comes down the track and is through his flick shot. Is not able to keep it down and the ball goes aerial. 'CATCH IT!' is the cry. But the ball goes right between short mid-wicket and mid on, racing to the fence.
Outside off, pushed towards point for a quick single.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
One again he dances out and this time he is to the pitch of the delivery. Drives it towards long off for a run.
Comes down the track but is not quite to the pitch of the ball. Gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A short ball outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Back of a length on off, Marsh stands firm on the crease and defends it off the backfoot.
In the channel outside off, Marsh lets it go.
Bouncer from Shami. Marsh nicely ducks underneath it.
Back of a length on middle, Marsh defends it from within the crease.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short delivery wide down leg. Marsh does not need to play at those.
Fuller ball outside off and TH takes a big stride forward to defend this with a straight bat.
Flatter delivery that is angling back into the pads, Head flicks it away to deep square leg and gets a couple. The 200 comes up for the hosts.
Flighted outside off this time, Head comes forward to defend it into the ground.
Shorter and outside off on this occasion, Marsh rocks back and cuts it towards deep point. Runs to the other end. Australia move to 199.
This one is on middle, Marsh defends it with soft hands to short mid-wicket.
Flatter ball outside off, Marsh comes forward to place this on the off side for a quick single. But the ball goes straight to cover.
Identical delivery, TH defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Back of a length on middle, Head defends it from within the crease.

FOUR! Bowls it short outside off, Marsh cuts it towards the backward point region and the ball races away ot the fence. Also brings up thr 50 run-stand between these two. Handy partnership after loosing the wicket of Handscomb early. Aussies would like these two to bat big now.
Good delivery from Shami. Short delivery from Shami, Head nicely defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Short of a length on middle, Marsh works it to the off side for a run.
Length delivery on off, Head pushes it towards point for a single.

FOUR! This is full and on middle. Marsh takes a stride ahead and drives this beautifully through mid on. Long off has no chance to come around and cut this as the ball races away to the fence. Good end to the over for the Aussies.
Flatter delivery on middle, defended back to the bowler off the back foot.
Another single as Head drives this flatter one off the back foot to long on.
Flatter delivery angling into the pads, Shaun pushes it toward mid-wicket and gets to the other end.

DROPPED! The ball goes in and out. Lapse of concentration from both the batsman and the keeper as Shaun looks to cut this short one outside off and gets a faint edge on it. Pant is off balance as he tries to catch it and ends up grassing this one as the ball fails to stick. The ball went into the gloves and maybe the keeper just failed to close the gloves in time as the ball trickled out and Marsh gets a life.
Well outside off and Marsh shoulders his arms to this one.
Woah! The movement there is really a lot as Head tries to defend this towards cover. Starting outside off on a good length, the ball moves away to beat the outside edge. Good bowling this!
Outside off and on a short length, the leftie is on his back foot as he defends this back to the bowler.
Another bouncer here, Travis ducks under it and lets it go through.

WIDE! A real effort ball this from Shami, the ball rises well above Head's head. Pant does well to jump and collect this in the end. The umpire signals a wide as it was too high and even 'first bouncer for the over'.
On a good length and angling back into the left-hander, he works it away to fine leg and gets a couple.
Another short one and Travis is deep in his crease as he defends this with a vertical bat.
Short of a length to start off with and Head defends it towards short mid-wicket.
Shami is back on.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle, Marsh watchfully defends it.
Quicker and flatter around off, Head rocks back and cuts it towards point for a single.
Quicker around off, Head lets it be.
Fuller delivery on middle, TH defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Tosses it up on middle, Head defends it with a straight bat.
Short length ball outside off left alone again by the southpaw. Maiden over.
Very full and outside off, Marsh looks to push it on the off side but gets the outside half of the bat and the ball goes towards point.
Left alone by Shaun and this time the ball behaves properly as it goes through to the keeper without moving.

A slight reminder about England for Pant, the ball flies and moves wildly after crossing the batsman. Another one outside off and on a length, the rookie keeper does well to get hands to this one and prevents any byes.
Another ball outside off and Pant collects this in front of Kohli at second slip as the ball moves a mile after crossing the batsman. Good take by the keeper.
Short of a length and outside off, the ball thuds into Pant's glove as Marsh lets it alone.
Flatter on middle, Shaun punches it off the backfoot towards point for a single.
A tad fuller just around off, SM shoulders arms to it.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags it short around off, Travis cuts it towards point for a run.
Quicker and fuller around off, Head lets it go.
Full around off, Head lets it be.
Another quick one on middle and short of a length. Marsh defends it straight back to the bowler.
Short of a length and on middle, coming back in with the angle. Head works it away to deep mic-wicket for a single. Marsh thinks of the second but is sent back rightly by Head.
Fuller length, overpitched on middle. The leftie flicks it away to the right of deep fine leg for a couple.
This ball is back on a good length and Travis tries to find the gap between slip and gully, but Rahane is quick to dive to his right and stop this ball. Would've been four had it gone through.
Bouncer to follow up, Head ducks under the ball and lets it go through.
On a length and outside off, Head is on his toes as he defends this towards point.

FOUR! Loose delivery from Vihari. It was short and wide outside off, Marsh cuts and cuts hard through the backward point region and the ball races away to the fence. Vihari needs to slower his pace. He has been wayyy to short and quicker in this over.
Flatter delivery on off, Marsh punches it towards the off side.
Tosses it up outside off, SM does not need to play at those.
Quicker and fuller around off, Marsh lets it go.
Identical delivery, same result.
Drags it short outside off, Marsh cuts it through point for a run.
Hanuma Vihari will roll his arm over.
Beaten outside off again! Too quick for the left-hander as the ball is past him before he gets his bat to play the cut shot. Bumrah is spitting fireballs here.
Another fast ball outside off, Travis has to jump to keep this out.

Nasty! Nasty bouncer from Bumrah. Quick and hurried onto Head who was attempting a pull but the ball is too quick on him. He gets hit on the glove and the ball then goes on to hit his helmet. Lucky for the batsman, the ball could've gone anywhere.
Angling into the body on this occasion, Marsh is cramped for room but adjust well as he works it away to square leg and gets a single.
Short of a length and well outside off this time, Marsh decides to let it go through. Well left.
Slightly full and outside off to start off with, Marsh defends it on the off side coming half forward.
Jasprit Bumrah comes back into the attack.
Angling on to the pads to end the over, Marsh works it away to mid-wicket and keeps strike by picking up a single.
Slightly pushes his length up on this occasion, the southpaw drives in in the gap through cover and gets to the other end.
Short and well outside off. No need to play at this one.
Good length ball outside off, Travis shoulders his arms at this one.
Good adjustment and much better from Head this time, a similar delivery outside off and he just opens the face this time to get the ball towards third man. The batsmen come back for two.

Outside off and another play and miss from Head. Riding his luck here one would say. Short of a length and Head wants to drive this off his back foot through covers but misses the ball completely. Loose, too loose a stroke to attempt now.
FOUR! Loosener from Umesh. Short delivery on middle, Marsh quickly pounces on it and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. A rare bad delivery from Umesh after Tea.
Back of a length around off, Marsh does not need to play at those.
Bouncer this time from Umesh. Marsh nicely ducks underneath it.
Beauty from Umesh. Back of a length around off, angling away. But Marsh nicely leaves it in the end.
In the channel outside off, Marsh shoulders arms to it.
Fuller delivery on off, Marsh defends it off the front foot and onto the ground.
This one is defended solidly off the back foot by the batsman.

Beaten again! Ishant delivers this one short and outside off, the left-handed Head goes for a cut off his back foot but misses the ball completely. Was too close to cut this one and especially risky on this pitch as the ball bounces a bit more than normal. Some stares from the bowler on his followthrough.
Short of a length and outside off, Travis punches it off his back foot towards mid off.
Bumpy delivery on middle and off, Head rises above it as he defends it into the ground.
Good length and back to being outside off, Head defends it confidently towards cover-point.

FOUR! This outfield is really quick! The ball was at the hips and Head just works it away off his pads to the right of deep fine leg. The fielder has no chance as the ball runs away to deep backward square leg fence.
Around off, Marsh lets it be.
Full on middle, Marsh defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Good shot from Marsh. Wide and short outside off, Marsh hangs back and cuts it through point and the ball races away to the fence.
In the channel outside off, Marsh lets it go.
Length delivery on middle, Head flicks it to the square leg region for a single.
Fuller delivery from Umesh on middle, Head defends it with a straight bat.
Outside off again and Shaun decides to let this one go through to the keeper. Good over from Sharma.

Play and miss! Ishant is making the ball move away after landing here. Marsh is on his back foot and tries to defend this short one on off, but the ball moves away in the last moment to beat his outside edge.
Short of a length and on top of off stump, Marsh is back in his crease as he defends this with a straight bat.
Outside off and Head just pushes it away towards point for a single.

FOUR! Almost had two-in-two. From around the wicket, and a snorter to welcome Head. He is uncomfortable as he tries to fend it off and looks like it has gone off his glove and above Kohli's head for four runs. Replays show us that the ball actually came off his left shoulder. Good bowling from Ishant here, looks like the wicket has given him confidence.
Travis Head is the next batsman in at no. 6.

OUT! Kohli has pulled off a one-handed stunner here! An incredible catch while jumping towards his right and Handscomb has to walk back. Ishant gets his first and India have their fourth. Just what they would've wanted after the Tea break. The ball is one that bounces way more than Handscomb would have expected as he puts his bat loose outside off in an attempt to run this one down to third man. He just gets an outside edge that flies to the right of Kohli at third slip. But lo and behold, the Indian skip just puts his hand out and the ball has stuck. Kind of thing that can lift the fielding team no limits. Australia have slipped from 112-0 to 148-4.
Ishant to bowl from the other end.
Three leaves in a row to end the over as this one too wide on the off side.
Another leave outside the off stump by the southpaw.
Well outside off on a good length, left alone by Shaun.

Well well, what happened there? Yadav goes for the bouncer and Marsh takes his eyes off the ball and tries to sway away. He is too late on it and the ball pings off his shoulder and drops just in front of Pant. No risk of getting out but there was a risk of a nasty injury there. Needs to keep his eyes on the ball.
Closer to the off pole this time, Peter drops it on the off side and runs through for a quick single.
Starts off with a ball short and well outside off, Handscomb just pushes it in the gap to the left of cover and picks up a couple.

We are back for the final session of play on Day 1. The players stroll out onto the field along with the umpires. Will we see Handscomb and Marsh build a partnership or will we see the Indians picking up quick wickets? Handscomb to face the first ball of the session from Umesh Yadav.
... DAY 1, SESSION 3 ...

It is a hot day and understandably, the Indians are taking a lot of time to bowl their overs. 37 left in the day. Surely we would be going into extra time, unless Vihari bowls more. Join us back at 3.20 pm local (0720 GMT).

Just goes to show you that a Test match is never over till it is actually over. At 112/0, the Aussies might have felt on top of the world, as the number 1 Test team was struggling to pick up a wicket. But suddenly, in the space of 79 balls, three have gone by and they now have two new batsmen out in the middle.

Sensational comeback from India. After a brief period post Lunch where they struggled in keeping the runs down, they have owned this session, picking up 3 wickets, which included both the set batsmen. With the heat forcing the cracks to open and widen, the batsmen are finding it more and more difficult to play.
Fine ball to end the session. Full and outside off, curling in late, a watchful Marsh takes his bat away. TEA ON DAY 1, AUSTRALIA ARE 145/3!
One more leave outside off.
Landed outside off, punched towards cover.
One more leave outside off.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, solidly defended.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on. 14-5-29-1 so far. This will be the last over before Tea.
BEAUTY TO END THE OVER! Brave leave or misjudgement? On a length outside off, Handscomb lets it go and the ball comes back in, going over the off stump!
Landed outside off, on a length, left alone.
Short and outside off, Handscomb arches back and punches it towards point.
Down the leg side, nudged fine for a single.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, Marsh leans and drives it through the covers for a couple.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, left alone.
Tossed up a bit, driven straight to mid off.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Outside off, Handscomb plays inside the line, expecting it to turn but misses.
Pitched outside leg, Shaun looks to flick but misses. There is an LBW appeal but it is turned down. Pitched outside leg.

FOUR RUNNING RUNS! Full and outside off, Marsh leans and drives it through the covers. Poor Hanuma Vihari gives it a chase, gets to the ball, pulls it back in near the boundary but by the time he does all that, the batsmen cross each other four times!
Outside off, left alone.
Fuller in length, outside off, Marsh looks to defend but misses.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for three runs.

The pitch is starting to play tricks now. Another one rises off a crack. Umesh lands it on a length, outside off, Handscomb looks to defend but the ball suddenly shoots up and hits the outside edge. However, Peter does well to keep the hands down and hence the ball does not carry to the slip cordon.
Around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Tossed up outside off, eased down to long off for a single. Gets off the mark.
Full and around off, Handscomb drives it straight back. Vihari dives to his right and parries it to shot mid-wicket.
The batsmen keep coming in quickly now... who is in next? Peter Handscomb.

OUT! Hanuma Vihari has got rid of the set batsman! Boy, what a move from Virat Kohli. That is what tomorrow's papers will read. But mind you, this has got more to do with the pitch. It is not even Tea on Day 1 but the cracks have already started to open and widen. It is a touch short outside off, Harris looks to cut but suddenly, out of nowhere, the ball bounces off the crack and cramps him for room. He cannot do anything apart from fend and unluckily for him, the ball hits the glove and lobs over Rishabh Pant to Ajinkya Rahane at first slip. Poor Hanuma Vihari is being mobbed by his team mates. They are over the moon in bright afternoon sunshine. Bonus wicket. Excellent knock from Harris though. Seemed to be playing on a different wicket as compared to the rest.
Outside off, punched uppishly towards point.
Haunma Vihari is back on. 1-0-9-0 so far. Tea is just around the corner - around 17 minutes away...
Pitched around middle and leg, Marsh looks to defend, then tries to let it go but misses and is hit on the chest.
A short ball, Harris plays a well-controlled pull shot through square leg for a run. Moves to 70.
Stays back in his crease and defends.
The crowd rises up as one again. This time its son is indeed off the mark. A short ball, around the hips, outside leg, Marsh nudges it towards fine leg and gets his scoreboard moving off 0.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through again.
Landed outside off, allowed to go through.
Full and just around off, solidly blocked out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

The crowd erupts for its local boy, only to realize that it is a leg bye. Around off, coming in, Marsh looked to tuck it away but missed. The ball went off his hips towards square leg. A single taken but the Western Australian is not off the mark. Because it is signalled a leg bye.
Around off, solidly pushed to the off side.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Outside off, tapped towards cover for a quick single.
Shaun Marsh comes in at number 4, replacing Khawaja.

OUT! Caught behind! Khawaja was never looking confident in his stay out there and has been relieved. He stands there in disbelief. Off his 37 strenuous deliveries, he has nicked off on his 38th. A nothing shot, to a short ball outside off. Just flayed hard, did not move his feet and paid the price. A well-deserved wicket for Umesh. He has been inconsistent but this will boost his spirits.
Outside off, let through.
Oopss.... a bit of a misjudgement. Landed outside off, Khawaja looks to defend but then tries to bail out. The ball goes off the bottom edge, on the bounce, to second slip.
Down the leg side, nudged fine for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a couple.
Landed outside off, defended from the crease.
Umesh Yadav returns. 9-2-33-0 so far.
Landed outside off, pushed towards cover.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Around off, defended from the crease.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

EDGED, DROPPED, FOUR! Tough chance for Rahul. Short and outside off, Harris looks to cut but gets an outside edge. The ball flies and the fielder leaps too, at second slip. The ball bursts through his palms and races to the third man fence.
Outside off, the sucker ball, fuller in length, Harris looks to drive but misses.
One more leave outside off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Landed outside off, left alone.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Outside off, left alone.
On middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, solidly defended.
The batsman appears to have been struck on the thigh pad.
Full and outside off, Khawaja looks to defend, gets an OUTSIDE EDGE but the ball does not carry to second slip.
Around off, Harris taps it towards point and takes a quick single. The calling is loud and efficient.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg. Good running to pick up three runs.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Mohammed Shami is back on. 13-5-27-1 so far.
Outside off, a poke and a miss.
Down the leg side, flicked fine for a single.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Outside off, left alone.
A sharp bouncer, Khawaja bails out of the pull shot.
Full and around off, Harris looks to defend but the ball squirts off the inside edge through square leg. A single taken.
On middle and straightens a tad bit after landing, Khawaja deals with it easily as he defends it with a straight bat and back to the bowler. Good over from Ishant though. Tight stuff.
Another one outside off and slightly shorter, Usman rocks back and defends it with soft hands.
Back to the off stump line, Khawaja doesn't look too confident defending this one but no danger in the end as the ball falls down on the pitch itself.
Around the wicket and sliding down at the pads with the angle, Harris pushes it in the gap towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
This one is on a good length and easily defended away towards cover. There is a stark difference in the pace of the two seamers operating right now, with Bumrah being quite a few clicks faster.
Some chin music for Harris here, but he ducks just under the ball and lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
Surprise yorker from Bumrah! Equally well played by Usman as he digs it out towards Kohli at cover. Good over. 3rd consecutive maiden for Bumrah.
Lots of time on this one as the leftie can shoulder his arms at it and let it go.
Another one which is bang on target and Khawaja remains on the back foot as he keeps it out.
Good length on off, Usman defends it with the straight bat.
This one has rared off the pitch and is fended off by the left-hander almost off his eye level. Well dealt with in the end and the ball rolls onto the pitch.
Outside off and short of a length, Usman wants nothing to do with it as he lets it go through.
Drinks break. India have finally broken through, now can they put some pressure on the Aussies and get a few more in quick time?
Well outside off, Harris shoulders his arms to let this one go to Pant.

Very poor from the Indian skipper! He has let Khawaja off the mark with an overthrow here. The pressure was building on Usman with 10 dot balls he had played and it is an unneccesary throw at the striker's end that Pant can't stop, that lets him get off the mark. India can do without such antics.
Shorter length delivery aimed at the hips, Harris flicks it away square on the leg side for a single.
Well outside off, left alone by the southpaw.

Harris suddenly looks a little nervy as he tries to cut this one just short of a length and outside off. He is late on it and the ball evades the outside edge once again as it goes through to the keeper.
Around the wicket from Ishant, it is on a length and holds its line. The batsman trusts the bounce and lets the ball through. It goes just above off and to Pant.
This ball moves away after landing outside off and the southpaw decides to not play at it. Second maiden on the trot by Jasprit.
Good length ball, Usman sees it well and defends it on the front foot.
This one is outside off and comes in with the angle. The left-hander covers the swing and then lets it go through to the keeper.
Back to the short length, Usman jumps a bit as he defends this off the back foot and into the ground on the off side.
Slightly fuller in length, seems like a surprise delivery after 3-4 short balls in a row. Khawaja does well to bring his bat down in time and defend to mid on.
Continues around the wicket, outside off and on a good length, Khawaja decides to let it go through.
Full on middle, Harris defends it from within the crease. Ishant starts off with a maiden.
Good length delivery on middle, Harris defends it off the front foot and onto the ground.
Outside off, the batsman shoulders arms to it.
Similar delivery, Harris defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
On middle, MH defends it with a straight bat.
Length delivery on middle, Harris tucks it to mid-wicket.
Ishant Sharma is back on.
Woah! Another play and miss! Khawaja prods at this one short and outside off tentatively and the ball tails away after landing just a shade to beat the outside edge. Good bowling by Bumrah.
Another one which is left alone by Usman, Bumrah is getting the ball to speed through now.
Well outside off this time, the batsman leaves it alone.

Beaten first ball! The ball is doing things suddenly for Bumrah. He looked a little inconsistent in the morning but the last three balls have been on point. This one is just outside off and is too good for a batsman first up. Khawaja tries to feel for the ball but is lucky not to get an outside edge on it.
Usman Khawaja is the next batsman in.

OUT! The first one finally goes. Finch seems to have been trapped plumb in front here. There was conviction in the appeal and yes, the finger goes up too. The ball was fuller and landed just outside off and tails in a bit after landing. Finch completely misses it and gets hit in front of middle. Doesn't go upstairs. Finch goes for 50. Replays show that the ball was going on to hit the middle of middle stump. A good decision not to review, looked plumb to the naked eye as well. Great opening partnership though, has put Australia ahead in the game.

A loud appeal! But the ball seems to be going over the stumps with the length being short on this occasion. Starts on middle and the ball holds its line and raps Finch who is on the back foot. India think about reviewing but decide against it, mostly because they have only 1 review left.
Jasprit Bumrah is back into the attack now.
Full and defended away easily by Harris.

FIFTY! 2nd Test fifty for Finch! Ball is wide outside off, Finch calmly pats it away to point and trudges to the other end to bring up his fifty. Looked very pokey in the beginning but has settled down well in the last 30 minutes or so.
Another outside edge on this ball, the ball runs towards backward point. Good comeback from Vihari after the first two balls.
Shortens the length, and immediately a doubt in Finch's mind. He prods at it and pushes it to point.
Two in two, full and wide outside off again, Finch has no half-measures in this one as he drives it slightly more square this time for four. Poor start from Hanuma.
Starts off with a rank half-volley outside off, Finch leans into it and drives it through the covers all the way for four.
Hanuma Vihari into the attack now.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven past cover but mid off backs it up nicely.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They've managed to run three.

100-RUN STAND IS UP! The Optus stands up as one. There have been some plays and misses but this pair has seen them all. Full and outside off, Harris taps it towards point and calls an unsure Finch for a quick single.
Around off, nicely played into the ground.
Good tight line, just outside off, angling away, left alone.
The batsman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A bouncer around middle, Harris ducks again. This time the bounce is not that high.
Outside off, left alone.
FIVE WIDES! Harsh on Umesh. A sharp bouncer, around middle, Harris ducks but the ball shoots up after landing. Poor Rishabh Pant leaps a furlong but the ball escapes his outstretched right glove.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and around off, well defended.
Around off, solidly blocked out. A testing over from Shami.
Full and around off, Finch looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half back towards mid on.
Down the leg side, Marcus tucks it towards fine leg for a run.
Outside off, this is a touch shorter, Marcus is unsure whether to play at it or not and misses.
Outside off, good pace, Harris feels for it but misses.
Down the leg side, Finch glances it fine for a single.
Down the leg side, Finch tucks it towards long leg and crosses over, retaining the strike.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and outside off, Harris plays away from his body and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies behind point and the batsmen take a run. The stand is now worth 90.
Around off, solidly defended.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Fine way to end the over! A bit short of a length outside off, Finch punches it through the covers and gets a boundary!

THERE IT IS! MAIDEN TEST FIFTY FOR MARCUS HARRIS! Well played, young man. He has shown grit, determination and patience. Full and around middle, Harris tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a quick single. Punches his fists in the air and celebrates.
FOUR! CARESSED! Full and outside off, Harris leans into this one and drives it through the covers for a boundary! Moves on to 49...
Around off, solidly defended.
Outside off, left alone.
On a length outside off, Harris feels for it but misses.
Outside off, loose from Finch, he flays and misses.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Landed outside off, left alone.
On a length outside off, Aaron looks to defend but the ball goes off the outside edge. Does not carry to gully.
Outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Full and around off, solidly defended.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, quietly left alone.
FOUR! Ho ho ho! Second of the over! Full and outside off again, plenty of width this time, Harris leans and drives it gloriously through the covers once more!
That is a lovely comeback. Hits the fuller length outside off, Marcus looks to drive but the ball stays low and beats him.
FOUR! That is a cracking shot. Full and wide outside off, Harris leans and drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Landed outside off, left alone.
Mohammed Shami to continue after Lunch.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Down the leg side, tucked towards fine leg for a single. The stand is now worth 70.
Around middle, curling in, pushed towards mid on.
Full and around off, swinging in, watchfully defended.
Good ball, nice shot, excellent running. Full and outside off, Finch leans and drives it through the covers. Virat Kohli gives it a good chase and the batsmen take three.
A loosener to start. Full and outside off, a touch wide, left alone.
Out come the players. The Indian take the field, followed by the Victorian pair of Harris and Finch. Umesh Yadav to start off proceedings for this session. 5-1-19-0 so far.
... DAY 1, SESSION 2 ...

Round 1 to Australia then. They have curbed their attacking instincts and have not got carried away. Though, they need to be a touch careful about getting frustrated as well. The last hour before Lunch was a testing period for them and so will be the first hour after the break. Considering the form that this batting line-up has shown, the opposition is never far from forging a collapse. Join us back at 1 pm local (0500 GMT).

A day ago, you could not actually spot the difference between the outfield and the pitch - it was so green. Though some of the grass has been shaved off, there is plenty of movement on this track. However, India could not quite make use of the new ball when it was hooping around. They have now reverted to the basics - bowling tight lines and lengths and inducing false strokes.

Unbelievable opening session for Australia. Though India pulled it back nicely after Drinks, but it has been the hosts' session. They set the tone in the first hour, going at nearly 4 an over and then have been cautious enough to not throw it away.
This is miles outside off, an easy leave for the batsman. LUNCH ON DAY 1, AUSTRALIA 66/0!
One more leave outside off.
Landed outside off, let through.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
A bit too straight, Finch looks to flick but misses. Shami starts to appeal but then bails out. The ball goes off Aaron's pads towards square leg and the batsmen take a run.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
Mohammed Shami time. The clock has ticked 12.20 pm local but we shall have one more over before Lunch.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off again, driven back to the bowler. Bumrah looks to stop by getting low to his right but he slips. Gets up gingerly but looks okay.
Around off, Aaron looks to defend but the ball comes back in sharply, hits the inside edge and rolls towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Finch defends solidly again.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, too full to be driven, hence Marcus gets a bottom edge.
Full and around off, cutting in, nicely played down the ground. There is mid on but Kohli from mid off gets to the ball quicker and the batsmen are restricted to a run.
Outside off, tapped towards point for a quick single.
Half volley outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full and miles outside off, left alone.
Around off, another tight line, AF looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Landed outside off, Aaron looks to drive but misses.

EDGED, FOUR! A run after a string of 21 dots. On a length outside off, Finch looks to drive but the ball moves away, takes the outside edge, albeit going onto the ground. Lokesh Rahul dives to his right at second slip but the ball is well wide of him and races to the third man fence. Would not have carried to the third slip fielder, even if he had been there.
Outside off, Aaron pushes it towards point.
And again! Another play and a miss. Similar ball, Aaron looks to drive again but gets beaten once more.

That is what happens when pressure mounts. T10 or T20 specialists cannot quite resist themselves. The patience is ticking over for both the Victorians here. Full and outside off, Finch looks to drive but misses. No feet movement.
Another one outside off, let through once again. That is the 5th maiden in the last 9 overs. Third on the trot. India piling on the pressure.
Landed outside off, fuller in length, left alone.

A gem from Harsha Bhogle on air. 'The boundaries in the 90s used to be so far that you needed to hire a rickshaw to get the ball back from the boundary!' No one laughs though. Probably no one got the pun or the joke.
On a length outside off, Marcus gets on top of the bounce and punches it through the covers but cannot quite get the gap. Finds the fielder.
Outside off, left alone.
A short ball outside off, Harris now plays a shot in anger. Looks to pull but misses.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Landed outside off, let through.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Around off, solidly defended.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Dangling the carrot again, full and outside off, but this time AF decides not to go for shopping or fishing. Lets it go. Good decision too. Swings away after pitching.

First real loose shot from Finch. The runs have dried up since Drinks and he is feeling frustrated. Full and outside off, Aaron looks to drive, without actually moving his feet. Almost a reminiscence of the way he got cleaned up by Ishant in Adelaide in the first innings. Is lucky this time because the ball misses the outside edge.

Misses out once more. Again, either Ishant is deliberately bowling slow or Harris not able to pick the change in pace. Another half volley, should have been driven through the covers, MH looks to drive it through the covers too. But just that change in pace is what he does not account for. As a result, the ball hits the bottom part of the bat and rolls towards mid off.
Landed outside off, angling away, left alone.
Full and outside off, Marcus gets a good stride forward, leans for the cover drive and plays that shot but probably a touch early. The ball hits the inner half of the bat and goes towards mid off.
Around middle and leg, well blocked out.
Probably a touch slower, outside off, fuller in length, Harris lets it go.
Starts off nicely, with a full ball around off, solidly defended.
Double change. Ishant Sharma is back on from the Justin Langer end. 4-2-14-0 so far.
Around off, cutting in off the seam, helped towards fine leg for a run.
Fuller and straighter, Marcus blocks it out watchfully.
Around off, solidly defended.

Close shave! On a length outside off, Aaron looks to play that through the off side but is tentative again. The ball takes the inside edge and narrowly misses the leg stump, en route square leg. A single taken.

Bad ball but Finch misses out. Short and wide outside off, begging to be hit, Aaron goes for the cut but a bit half-heartedly. Hanuma Vihari at point does a favour on his bowler by diving to his left and parrying it to gully.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Jasprit Bumrah into the attack now. 5-0-20-0 so far. The 12th man has just come onto the ground with some drinks. A very, very hot day.
Around off, pushed to the off side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
One more leave outside off.
Outside off, left alone.

Around off, coming in, Finch looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge. Harris spots that the fielder at short mid-wicket is a touch stationary and immediately calls for the single. Good awareness.
Down the leg side, coming in, Harris tucks it towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, coming in, let go.
Around off, defended from the crease.
Full and outside off, Aaron drives it through the covers where Hanuma Vihari dives to his right and parries it wide of mid off. But the batsmen do not run.
The batsman has driven it towards mid on.
Another lovely drive, this time towards mid on.

Good ball, lovely shot, excellent fielding! Great cricket all around. Full and straight, hitting the stumps but for the bat coming in between. Finch drives it with an absolute straight bat. The ball goes like a rocket down the ground but Umesh sticks out his right leg and deflects the ball to cover.
Nicely set up. After bowling outswingers, Shami shapes this one in. Finch though is prepared for it and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, shouldered arms to.
Around off, pushed towards mid on.

'YEAHHH, NOOOOOOOOOOO!' is the call from Finch. You never take Kohli on so often. Full and outside off, Aaron pushes it through cover-point, sets off for a single as he first sees point going to his right. But the next second, he observes Virat Kohli moving swiftly to his left and he quickly changes his mind.
Around off, solidly defended.

Huge shout for LBW again. Not out once more. Kohli asks Shami for a review. The bowler shakes his head. On a length outside off, comes back in a long way after pitching. Finch misses his tuck and is hit on the pads, slightly above the knee roll. Definitely a touch high but the impact might have been outside off as well.
Around off, well blocked out.

FOUR! What a shot. Not an easy one to play at all, especially with that height. David Warner usually plays that shot, but with both feet in the air. Harris though, has his feet grounded. Fractionally short of a length outside off, Marcus arches back, goes down a touch and plays a punch through the point zone. The best part about it was that the ball was not aerial at all. 50-RUN STAND COMES UP. At a good rate too.
Similar ball to the one bowled a couple of deliveries ago, this time Marcus defends.
Around off, solidly defended.

BRAVE LEAVE! Close leave! My word, either Harris trusts the bounce on this wicket or he did not expect that ball to come in. It was pitched outside off, on a length and the Victorian shouldered arms. But to his alarm, the cherry came back in a long way and went off something to the keeper, which not surprisingly, prompted an appeal. Replays show that it clipped the left pocket of his trouser.
On the pads, Harris flicks it through mid-wicket. Hanuma Vihari gives it a good chase and keeps the batsmen in their crease as they look for the third, with a sharp throw to the keeper.
Landed outside off, AF knows where his off stump is and shoulders arms.
Landed just outside off, Aaron comes forward and blocks again.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Similar ball, Aaron comes forward again and defends once more.
Around off, tight line, well blocked out.
Full and outside off, Finch looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat back to the bowler.

Full and around middle and leg, Marcus flicks but slips as well in his followthrough. Gets it through mid-wicket. Takes a couple, wants the third but Aaron Finch slips at the other end and the openers abort the thought.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, on a length, Harris feels for it but the ball moves away off the seam, beating the outside edge.
Around off, solidly defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Around off, well blocked out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Another LBW appeal belched out. Turned down again. Kohli asks for the review once more. This time, Shami himself is not interested. Similar ball to the previous one, coming in with the angle, Aaron misses his flick again, getting hit on the pads. Again, the umpire is unmoved. Height was the factor again. This time though, Hawk Eye showed it to be clipping the top of middle stump.

NOT OUT! MISSING THE STUMPS! Hmmm... the Perth bounce. On a length around off, coming in, Finch looked to defend but missed it due to the bounce staying a touch low. Got hit on the pads and Shami roared. Kohli roared. The people from behind the stumps were not so ecstatic on the review but an adamant Kohli wanted it. Well, it did look close on the replays but Hawk Eye showed it to be going over.
Review time! India are confident that Finch is plumb LBW. Looks mighty close.
Mohammed Shami into the attack as well.
FOUR! Edged away. On a length outside off, Harris feels for it but the ball away, takes the outside edge and goes past gully to the third man fence.
On middle, MH defends it with a straight bat.
Back of a length outside off, Harris shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery around off, Harris lets it be.
Harris drives it straight past the bowler and towards mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length around off. Harris lets it be.
Around off and outside off, solidly defended.
Full and outside off, coming in with the angle, left alone.

Terrific effort from Virat Kohli. Full and outside off, Harris leans into the shot and drives it through the covers. The ball almost races to the boundary and Kohli and Umesh Yadav chase it in pairs. The skipper gets to the ball, dives and then flicks it back. It rolls back in, but the third umpire does not check that in the replays whether it touches the ropes. All he checks is whether Virat stopped the ball before it reached the boundary which he did. Three runs given.
Is that a boundary? Or has superman Kohli stopped the ball?

Well bowled, well played. A short ball outside off, coming in with the angle, Harris looks to defend but suddenly the ball bounces sharply. He is taken aback but does well to drop his wrists and play it onto the ground. The ball takes the outside edge but does not stay in contact with the air for long. Goes on three bounces to the gully fielder.
Outside off, on a length, left alone.

Excellent running but lack of match awareness from Cheteshwar Pujara. A bit too straight from Bumrah, Finch clips it through mid-wicket and calls for two. Pujara gets to the ball and then lazily turns around. Now, the openers have a look at his approach and then at each other. They start to run the third but Cheteshwar still does not release the ball. He jogs a couple of steps and then throws, which allows the third to be completed easily.

DIRECT HIT, BUT OVERTHROWS! Fuller delivery on middle, Aaron pushes it towards cover and goes for the run.
