Kohli then has a shy at the non-striker's end but the batsmen make it home and get a run as well. There was no fielder to back it up and the batsmen get another couple of runs there in that process.

MIX-UP, BUT SAFE! Length delivery on off, Finch taps it towards cover and sets off for a single. But Harris sees that it is Kohli over there and sends his partner back. Kohli has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Finch was in and even wants an overthrow but square leg backs up.
A tad fuller on off, Finch guides it to the point region.
Back of a length on middle, Aaron defends it from within the crease.
Similar delivery on middle, Finch lets it go.
Starts off with a fuller delivery around off, Finch shoulders arms to it.
Umesh Yadav into the attack now.
Landed outside off, Harris shuffles across and lets it go.
Full and outside off, driven straight to mid off.
Nice and compact from Aaron. Pushes it towards cover and gets across to the other end for a quick single.
Comes in from outside off, a long way in, Aaron pushes it watchfully towards the bowler.
Around off, Finch opens the face of his bat slightly and pushes it towards Ajinkya Rahane at gully.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Bumrah comes charging in but Finch moves away. Either he was not ready or got distracted with Kohli shouting from behind. The Indian captain is eager for a short leg. Now that man comes.
BEATEN! Good length delivery around off, Harris tries to push it towards point but was beaten by the pace of the delivery. But a good over for the Aussies. Three boundaries from the over.

FOUR! Make it two in two balls. Identical delivery, Harris again drives it straight past the bowler. This time to the other side. Through mid off. Playing in the 'V'. Good positive batting from the opener.
FOUR! It was bowled full on middle, Harris stylishly drives it straight past the bowler through mid on and the ball races away to the boundary. Good shot that from Harris.
Length delivery on middle, Harris defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller length outside off, Harris does not need to play at those.

NO BALL! Length delivery around off. Harris lets it be. Umpire calls it no ball for overstepping. There we go again. The first no ball of this Test match and it has come from Ishant. He must be tearing his out more than anybody else. He was very frustrated with himself in the previous game.
FOUR! Errs in line and length and gets the punishment for it. Bowls it full down leg, Harris tickles it fine off his pads and the ball races away to the boundary.
FOUR! Streaky but effective. Back of a length around off, Finch opens the face of the bat and guides it towards gully and the ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length on middle, Aaron defends it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Harris off the mark after 15 balls. It was bowled full down leg, Harris clips it to the fine leg region for a run.
Length delivery outside off, Harris lets it be.
Fuller delivery around off, Harris lets it go to the keeper.
Good length delivery from Bumrah, Harris tries to tap it towards point but gets an inside onto the pads.
Full and perhaps a bit too straight, pushed towards mid on.
Slips this down the leg side, Finch misses his flick. Another boundary-scoring opportunity goes by.
That is a good ball but perhaps the length is too short on this type of a pitch. Outside off, AF walks into the shot and looks to defend but misses.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, Aaron looks to drive but there is no feet movement. The ball rolls off the inner half back to the bowler.
On a length around off, Finch gets across to flick but misses as he falls over. Is hit high on the pads.
Fuller this time on middle, Finch works it to the leg side for a run. Good probing over from Bumrah comes to an end.
Another brilliant delivery from Bumrah. Bowls it full outside off, Finch tries to flick it but it goes between the bat and the pad.
Super delivery that from Bumrah. It was a tad full around off, Finch goes for the drive but fails to do so. Finch was lucky not to get the outside edge of the bat.
Back of a length on middle, Finch defends it off the back foot and onto the ground.
Good delivery that on off. Aaron shoulders arms to it.
Fuller delivery from Bumrah on middle, Finch flicks it wide of mid on.  Shami runs hard to stop it but the batsmen manage to get two runs in the process.
Bowls it wayyy down leg. A touch short of a good length down the leg side, Harris looks to pull but misses out on a boundary ball. Rishabh Pant does really well to dive to his right to stop it.
Fuller delivery on middle, Harris defends it by presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length delivery from Ishant on off, MH lets it be.
Length delivery on off, Harris taps it to the point region.
Good running. That is the second time he has done that in the last 3 balls. Full and just outside off, Aaron presses forward and pushes it towards cover for a quick single.
Full and wide outside off, Finch lunges and shoulders arms.
A tad fuller on off, Harris drives it firmly but straight to the cover fielder.
Bumrah bowls it full around off, Harris does not need to play at those.
Back of a length on off, Finch taps it to point for a run.
FOUR! Finch off the mark with a brilliant pull shot. It was dragged short and Finch pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Good positive start from the opener.
Goes short this time. Aaron tries to pull it but misses it completely. Some good bounce on this wicket for Bumrah.
Starts off with a back of a length delivery on middle, Finch defends it from within the crease.
Jasprit Bumrah to share the new ball.
Identical delivery, Harris lets it go. Good start from Ishant.
Length delivery around off, Harris shoulders arms to it.
Length delivery this time on off, MH defends it off the front foot and onto the ground.
Before the over began, Ishant Sharma was checking his runup. He was very angry with himself over the no balls in the previous Test.
Good delivery that. Fuller delivery swings away a bit. Marcus goes for the drive but fails to do so. Swing on offer here for Ishant.
Length delivery around off, Harris lets it go to the keeper.
Starts off with a fuller delivery on leg, Harris tries to flick it but misses it.
The players are out in the middle. Aaron Finch and Marcus Harris comes out to bat for Australia. Ishant Sharma will start the proceedings.

Indian captain, Virat Kohli, says that he would have batted first as well but does not feel it is a bad toss to lose on a green wicket. Now wants his side to bowl well. On the track, Kohli says that he saw an ODI on this wicket where the seamers made merry. Feels nice to watch how the wicket plays and bat second. Does not want his side to be complacent and given the Adelaide Test, he understands that nothing is going to be given easy. Wants his unit to learn from the mistakes committed in the first match and do better here. Informs that India are going in with two forced changes - Rohit Sharma and Ravichandran Ashwin are injured and are replaced by Hanuma Vihari and Umesh Yadav respectively.

Australian skipper, Tim Paine, says that it is a very warm day and is looking behind at the Shield game (domestic match) last week. Expects the workload on the quicks to be heavy with the weather expected to get hotter during the Test. On the tough schedule, Paine says that it is the way it is these days and players have to adjust for a quick turnaround. Does not want to focus on the last loss and insists that the team is out to win and level the series.
TOSS - We are ready for the spin of the coin. Isa Guha is with the captains. Tim Paine flips the coin, Heads is the call from Virat Kohli but it is a Tail. AUSTRALIA ELECT TO BAT FIRST.

PITCH REPORT - Michael Vaughan doing the pitch report expects plenty of movement and bounce with a lot of grass around. But does not want to take the spinners for granted and expects them to come good as well.
WEATHER - It is a hot day in Perth and the conditions are expected to worsen as the match goes on.

This is the first ever Test match at this venue, with Optus hosting just one ODI between Australia and South Africa not too long ago. There has been just one First-Class match over here, hence, there is not much data to fall back on.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd Test between Australia and India from Perth. The team in Blue will be high on confidence after taking a 1-0 lead in the 4-match Test series. With the bowlers doing their job, Virat will like his batters to contribute a bit more and score big. Coming to the home team, they have a lot to worry, especially their batting. Their batting has been a failure and Paine would like his top order to score heavy runs if they want to level in this series. Should be an intriguing Test match.
